Provides a resource to create a cls cloud product log task

> **NOTE:** In the destruction of resources, if cascading deletion of logset and topic is required, please set `isDeleteTopic` and `isDeleteLogset` to `true`.

## API Reference

This resource interacts with the following TencentCloud APIs:

* Create:
  - [CreateCloudProductLogCollection](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/80568)
  - [DescribeCloudProductLogTasks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/80566)
* Read:
  - [DescribeCloudProductLogTasks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/80566)
  - [DescribeLogsets](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/42778)
  - [DescribeTopics](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/42783)
* Update: [ModifyCloudProductLogCollection](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/80565)
* Delete:
  - [DeleteCloudProductLogCollection](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/80567)
  - [DeleteLogset](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/42779)
  - [DeleteTopic](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/42784)
  - [DescribeCloudProductLogTasks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/614/80566)

<ul>

<li>Long region code (e.g., <code>ap-guangzhou</code>, <code>ap-shanghai</code>): applies to CDS (all), MongoDB-SlowLog, MongoDB-ErrorLog, MongoDB-OperationLog, DNSPod-RESOLVELOG, HTTPDNS-RESOLVELOG, MDP-SSAI, CFS-AUDIT, TEO-INEFERENCE, CSIP, TCSS, TSE, CWP, KHL.</li>
<li>BH Polaris name: applies to BH (all), values: <code>overseas-polaris</code> (Hong Kong and overseas), <code>fsi-polaris</code> (finance zone), <code>general-polaris</code> (general zone), <code>intl-sg-prod</code> (international site).</li>

## Import



cls cloud product log task can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cls/cloudProductLogTaskV2:CloudProductLogTaskV2 example postgres-1p7xvpc1#PostgreSQL#PostgreSQL-SLOW#gz
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
